# Weather Log Planner

Record a short observation each morning: sky condition, temperature range,
wind feel, and one line about how it compared to yesterday. Weekly, review
the notes for patterns worth planning around.

## Weekend planning

Use accumulated notes to pick realistic outdoor windows. Prefer mornings
after calm nights. Postpone errands when consecutive wet days are logged.

- Log time and place consistently so entries remain comparable.
- Flag any extreme readings for later verification.
